scripts.cf:preview: pnpm cf:build && pnpm wrangler pages dev
scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: A fresh D1 database for your Pulse instance. Schema migrations run automatically on every deploy.

RECEIPTS.description: A fresh R2 bucket that stores receipt images you attach to money entries.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: A random 32+ character string that signs your session cookies. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Your deployed instance URL (e.g. https://pulse.<you>.workers.dev). You can update this after the first deploy prints the URL.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Free API key from https://console.groq.com — powers voice capture, natural-language entry, and weekly insights.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Free API key from https://resend.com — sends your magic-link sign-in email. The free tier delivers to your own Resend signup address, which is all a single-user instance needs.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional (web push). Generate with: node scripts/generate-vapid-keys.mjs — paste the public key.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional (web push). The private key printed alongside VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY by the same command.

CRON_SECRET.description: Any long random string that guards the scheduled endpoints. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32
